feature: TypeScript path aliases are import edges
description: An import specifier matching a tsconfig.json compilerOptions.paths pattern, inherited through relative extends, resolves to the project file it maps to, in both hexa analyze and the code graph; anything else is unchanged.

specs.description: An @/ alias resolves to the project file under src, and the edge is judged by that file's layer.
specs.given: A project whose root tsconfig.json has compilerOptions.paths {"@/*": ["./src/*"]} and no baseUrl; files src/domain/order.ts (domain) and src/adapters/secondary/http.ts (adapters/secondary); src/domain/order.ts contains `import { get } from "@/adapters/secondary/http"` on line 3
specs.when: hexa analyze runs on the project
specs.then: There is an ImportEdge from src/domain/order.ts to src/adapters/secondary/http.ts with from_layer domain, to_layer adapters_secondary, import_path "@/adapters/secondary/http" and line 3, and it is reported as a DependencyViolation

specs.description: The resolved alias target tries the same extensions and index files a relative import tries.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json paths {"@/*": ["./src/*"]}; the file src/lib/http/index.ts exists, and neither src/lib/http.ts nor src/lib/http.tsx exists; src/app/main.ts imports "@/lib/http"
specs.when: The imports of src/app/main.ts are resolved
specs.then: The import's resolved_path is src/lib/http/index.ts, which is the same file the relative import "../lib/http" from src/app/main.ts resolves to

specs.description: Targets are tried in order and the first that names a project file wins.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json paths {"@shared/*": ["./generated/*", "./src/shared/*"]}; src/shared/money.ts exists, and nothing exists under generated/; src/app/a.ts imports "@shared/money"
specs.then: The edge's to_file is src/shared/money.ts

specs.description: When both targets name a project file, the earlier target wins.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json paths {"@shared/*": ["./generated/*", "./src/shared/*"]}; both generated/money.ts and src/shared/money.ts exist; src/app/a.ts imports "@shared/money"
specs.then: The edge's to_file is generated/money.ts and not src/shared/money.ts

specs.description: Targets are relative to baseUrl when it is set.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json has compilerOptions {"baseUrl": "./web", "paths": {"@/*": ["src/*"]}}; web/src/lib/http.ts exists and src/lib/http.ts does not; web/src/app/a.ts imports "@/lib/http"
specs.then: The edge's to_file is web/src/lib/http.ts

specs.description: A pattern with no wildcard matches only the exact specifier.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json paths {"config": ["./src/config/index.ts"]}; src/config/index.ts exists; src/app/a.ts imports "config"
specs.then: The edge's to_file is src/config/index.ts

specs.description: The portal reproducer reports every real violation.
specs.given: The fixture a local fixture, ts-path-aliases-portal, at commit b046c9f, with its tsconfig.json alias @/* -> ./src/* and the portal's layer map
specs.when: hexa analyze runs on the fixture
specs.then: 5 violations are reported, among them the 3 whose import_path begins with "@/", where before this change 2 were reported

specs.description: A relative path in baseUrl is resolved against the declaring tsconfig, not against the importing file.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json paths {"@/*": ["./src/*"]}; files src/lib/http.ts and src/app/src/lib/http.ts both exist; src/app/a.ts imports "@/lib/http"
specs.then: The edge's to_file is src/lib/http.ts and not src/app/src/lib/http.ts

specs.description: A wildcard matches at most once, and a pattern's prefix must match literally.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json paths {"@/*": ["./src/*"]}; src/lib/http.ts exists; src/app/a.ts imports "@lib/http" (no slash after @)
specs.then: No edge to src/lib/http.ts is created: the specifier does not match "@/*" and stays "@lib/http" as written

specs.description: A pattern's target that names no file is skipped, and is never taken as the edge's target.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json paths {"@/*": ["./missing/*", "./src/*"]}; src/lib/http.ts exists and missing/lib/http.ts does not; src/app/a.ts imports "@/lib/http"
specs.then: The edge's to_file is src/lib/http.ts; no edge names missing/lib/http.ts or missing/lib/http

specs.description: An alias import and the relative import of the same file make the same edge.
specs.given: Any project whose root tsconfig.json maps a pattern to a target, and any importing file F and project file T such that a specifier S matches the pattern and the first target to name a project file names T, and R is a relative specifier from F that resolves to T
specs.when: F imports T once through S and, in a second copy of the project, once through R
specs.then: The two edges have the same from_file, to_file, from_layer and to_layer, and one is a violation exactly when the other is; only import_path differs

specs.description: paths and baseUrl are inherited through a relative extends, and baseUrl is relative to the file that declares it.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json is {"extends": "./config/tsconfig.base.json"} with no compilerOptions; config/tsconfig.base.json has compilerOptions {"baseUrl": "..", "paths": {"@/*": ["src/*"]}}; src/lib/http.ts exists; src/app/a.ts imports "@/lib/http"
specs.then: The edge's to_file is src/lib/http.ts, because baseUrl ".." is taken relative to config/

specs.description: Settings in the extending file win over the base.
specs.given: config/tsconfig.base.json has paths {"@/*": ["./legacy/*"]}; root tsconfig.json extends "./config/tsconfig.base.json" and has its own paths {"@/*": ["./src/*"]}; both legacy/lib/http.ts and src/lib/http.ts exist; src/app/a.ts imports "@/lib/http"
specs.then: The edge's to_file is src/lib/http.ts

specs.description: extends is followed through more than one level.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json extends "./tsconfig.app.json", which extends "./tsconfig.base.json", which declares paths {"@/*": ["./src/*"]}; src/lib/http.ts exists; src/app/a.ts imports "@/lib/http"
specs.then: The edge's to_file is src/lib/http.ts

specs.description: An extends that names a package is not followed.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json is {"extends": "@tsconfig/strictest/tsconfig.json"} with no paths of its own; node_modules/@tsconfig/strictest/tsconfig.json declares paths {"@/*": ["./src/*"]}; src/lib/http.ts exists; src/app/a.ts imports "@/lib/http"
specs.then: The specifier stays "@/lib/http" as written and no edge to src/lib/http.ts is created

specs.description: An inherited baseUrl is not rebased onto the extending file's directory.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json extends "./config/base.json"; config/base.json has baseUrl "./web" and paths {"@/*": ["src/*"]}; both config/web/src/lib/http.ts and web/src/lib/http.ts exist; src/app/a.ts imports "@/lib/http"
specs.then: The edge's to_file is config/web/src/lib/http.ts, because baseUrl is taken relative to the file that declares it, and not web/src/lib/http.ts

specs.description: Moving compilerOptions into a relatively extended file, with paths rewritten to the same locations, changes no edge.
specs.given: Any project P1 whose root tsconfig.json declares paths and baseUrl directly, and P2, identical except that the root extends a base file by relative path which declares paths and a baseUrl pointing to the same directory, and the root declares neither
specs.when: hexa analyze runs on P1 and on P2
specs.then: Both have the same set of edges (from_file, to_file, from_layer, to_layer, line) and the same violations

specs.description: A package import stays external.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json paths {"@/*": ["./src/*"]}; src/app/a.ts imports "react" and "@tanstack/react-query"
specs.then: Both resolved paths are the specifiers as written, they name no project file, and neither produces a violation

specs.description: A project with no paths grades exactly as before.
specs.given: A TypeScript project whose tsconfig.json has no compilerOptions.paths, with relative and package imports
specs.when: hexa analyze runs on it before and after this change
specs.then: violations, edge_count and health_score are identical

specs.description: A matched alias whose targets name no project file is not invented into an edge.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json paths {"@/*": ["./src/*"]}; src/lib/ghost.ts does not exist, nor any extension or index file at src/lib/ghost; src/domain/a.ts (domain) imports "@/lib/ghost"
specs.then: The specifier stays "@/lib/ghost" as written: no edge names src/lib/ghost.ts and no violation is reported for that import

specs.description: A scoped package that only resembles an alias is not rewritten.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json paths {"@/*": ["./src/*"]}; src/types/node.ts exists; src/app/a.ts imports "@types/node"
specs.then: The specifier stays "@types/node" and no edge to src/types/node.ts is created

specs.description: Only specifiers that resolve through a pattern change.
specs.given: Any project and any non-relative specifier that matches no paths pattern or whose targets name no project file
specs.then: Its resolved path equals the resolution before this change

specs.description: graph consumers counts files that import through an alias.
specs.given: Root tsconfig.json paths {"@/*": ["./src/*"]}; src/lib/http.ts; src/a.ts imports "@/lib/http", src/b/c.ts imports "../lib/http"
specs.then: Both src/a.ts and src/b/c.ts are listed, a count of 2

specs.description: The graph does not count unresolvable aliases or packages as consumers.
specs.given: Same tsconfig; src/x.ts imports "@/lib/ghost" (no such file) and "react"
specs.then: src/x.ts is not listed

specs.description: The graph and analyze agree on every TypeScript import edge.
specs.given: Any TypeScript project with any tsconfig.json paths and extends
specs.when: hexa analyze and the code graph resolve all imports
specs.then: For every import, the graph's target file equals the analyze edge's to_file, so consumers of a file are exactly the from_files of edges to it
